import json
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # find border rectangle of 5s
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(x==5 for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j]==5 for i in range(h))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    # find colored markers outside rectangle
    marks={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v not in (0,5): marks[v]=(i,j)
    vs=sorted(marks, key=lambda v: marks[v][1])  # left then right
    L,R=vs
    ri0,ri1=r0+1,r1-1; ci0,ci1=c0+1,c1-1
    rm=(ri0+ri1+1)//2; cm=(ci0+ci1+1)//2
    for i in range(ri0,rm):
        for j in range(ci0,cm): g[i][j]=L
        for j in range(cm,ci1+1): g[i][j]=R
    for i in range(rm,ri1+1):
        for j in range(ci0,cm): g[i][j]=R
        for j in range(cm,ci1+1): g[i][j]=L
    return g
